root_causes.title: Socket.IO signaling contract is absent

evidence.finding: Socket.IO server is initialized, but no connection, handler, or emit contract exists.
Socket.IO client is initialized with io(), but no signaling event contract exists.

root_causes.effect: There is no implemented application-level signaling path for WebRTC offer, answer, or ICE exchange.

root_causes.title: WebRTC negotiation and ICE lifecycle is absent

evidence.finding: The following WebRTC APIs are absent: createOffer, createAnswer, setLocalDescription, setRemoteDescription, addIceCandidate, onicecandidate
